heldout_policy: model revision, parent state, and lineage group are disjoint across train, validation, and test
resource_accounting: analytical proxies derived from the shared linear predictor and bounded input features; no measured inference performance or proven upper bounds
selection_policy: select the topology/history feature path only when its validation MAE interval is strictly below the pooled-linear baseline interval and analytical proxy budgets pass; report test metrics after the decision
censoring: unsupported, failed, and unknown outcomes are retained but excluded from fitting and measured metrics
findings: v1 evaluated and serialized test metrics before choosing among paths on those same test outcomes, allowing test-set selection bias
v1 labels implied distinct MLP, set-transformer, and graph-surgeon encoders although every arm used the same linear model
v1 resource figures used arbitrary architecture multipliers rather than each path's actual parameter count
claim_boundary: This study compares aggregate input feature paths for one standardized linear predictor. It is not evidence for a learned graph/set architecture or improved physical model optimization.
